approaches_tried.approach: Initial glyph insertion via a regex-driven Python script matching `name = "X"\n    arity = N` blocks
approaches_tried.reason: Backslash-escaping mismatch between the Python string literal building the regex and the two literal backslash characters actually present in the theory .py source text (e.g. source contains `\\neg`, matching regex needed 4 backslash chars, script only produced 2). Switched to plain str.find/str.replace on raw-string markers (r"\\neg") which match the literal source bytes directly.

deviations.description: Loading logos's constitutive+modal subtheories (which transitively loads counterfactual) raised DuplicateOperatorError('\u25a1\u2192 already registered') at import time
deviations.reason: code/src/model_checker/theory_lib/logos/subtheories/counterfactual/candidates.py defines six context-free candidate operator subclasses (ImpositionLocalCounterfactual, WorldStateCounterfactual, SettlerCounterfactual, SettlingImpositionClosureCounterfactual, ExactSettlingImpositionCounterfactual, GeneratedSettlerCounterfactual) that subclass CounterfactualOperator (via CandidateCounterfactual) without declaring their own `name`-distinct `aliases`, so they inherited CounterfactualOperator's "\u25a1\u2192" alias and collided with it and each other the moment more than one was registered together. This file was outside the plan's originally-scoped 7 theory operators.py files. Fixed by adding an explicit `aliases: List[str] = []` override on the shared `CandidateCounterfactual` base class. The identical pattern recurred in theory_lib/imposition/operators.py's LogosCounterfactual (subclasses the aliased CounterfactualOperator under the import alias LogosCounterfactualOperator) and was fixed the same way (explicit `aliases = []`).
